name: bambulab-metrics-exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for Bambu Lab printers on Unraid. Exposes /metrics, /health, and /ready. Quick setup: 1) Set required values: BAMBULAB_TRANSPORT, BAMBULAB_SERIAL, BAMBULAB_SECRET_KEY (example: openssl rand -base64 48). 2) cloud_mqtt: set BAMBULAB_CLOUD_EMAIL (code/token fields can be left empty for first run and may auto-populate). 3) local_mqtt: set BAMBULAB_HOST and BAMBULAB_ACCESS_CODE. Then start the container and open WebUI for status. Scrape /metrics from Prometheus.

variables.name: Listen Host
variables.description: HTTP bind host

variables.name: Listen Port
variables.description: HTTP bind port

variables.name: Transport
variables.description: Select transport mode

variables.name: Printer Serial
variables.description: Printer device serial (required)

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Strong key for encrypted credentials. Generate example: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: Cloud Email
variables.description: Used only when Transport=cloud_mqtt. Recommended/required for automatic cloud auth flow.

variables.name: Cloud One-Time Code
variables.description: Used only when Transport=cloud_mqtt. Optional verification code from email; if empty, startup can trigger code flow and ask for restart.

variables.name: Cloud User ID
variables.description: Used only when Transport=cloud_mqtt. Usually auto-filled by startup auth process; can stay empty on first run.

variables.name: Cloud Access Token
variables.description: Used only when Transport=cloud_mqtt. Usually auto-filled by startup auth process; leave empty unless setting manually.

variables.name: Cloud Refresh Token
variables.description: Used only when Transport=cloud_mqtt. Auto-filled when available by startup auth process; optional for manual setup.

variables.name: Cloud MQTT Host
variables.description: Cloud MQTT host

variables.name: Cloud MQTT Port
variables.description: Cloud MQTT port

variables.name: Local Host/IP
variables.description: Used only when Transport=local_mqtt. Required printer IP/hostname.

variables.name: Local Access Code
variables.description: Used only when Transport=local_mqtt. Required LAN access code from printer settings.

variables.name: Local MQTT Port
variables.description: Used only when Transport=local_mqtt. Usually keep default 8883.

variables.name: Local MQTT Username
